dedupe_keys.name: electrical power measurements from multiple grid connected photovoltaic systems on the rooftop of etsidi upm madrid spain

description: Electrical power measurements from multiple grid-connected photovoltaic systems on the rooftop of ETSIDI-UPM (Madrid, Spain) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Oscar Perpiñán-Lamigueiro, Julio Amador-Guerra (Universidad Politécnica de Madrid). This dataset contains electrical power measurements from a set of grid-connected photovoltaic systems installed on the rooftop of the ETSIDI (UPM), located at 40°24'19.4"N 3°42'10.1"W in Madrid, Spain. Measurements include DC power, AC power and power factor collected by measuring units of Carlo Gavazzi (VMUSAV30XSXX for DC power and EM112DINAV01XS1X for AC power). Coverage: national (ES); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
